findings.description: When n == 0, the function returns the original start date without moving a weekend start to the following Monday, contradicting the requirement that n == 0 returns the following Monday on a weekend.
findings.evidence: For example, add_business_days(date(2026, 11, 5), 0) should return date(2026, 11, 7) but currently returns date(2026, 11, 5).

review.summary: Candidate implementation does not shift a weekend start to Monday when adding zero business days, violating the contract.
